footer.aiNote: Study uses AI to work with your material. AI can make mistakes, so Study always shows where something comes from.

hero.title: Learn from your own material.
hero.lead: Add your notes and chapters. Study turns them into summaries, flashcards, practice questions and study sessions, and always shows where it found things in your material.
hero.demoLabel: Example: a passage from your material and the flashcard made from it
hero.demoPassageBefore: When prices rise faster than wages,
hero.demoPassageHighlight: purchasing power falls: the same income buys less
hero.demoPassageAfter: . This is called a fall in real income.
hero.demoQuestion: What happens to your purchasing power when prices rise faster than your wage?
hero.demoAnswer: It falls. The same income buys less.

add.title: Add your material
add.body: Paste text or upload a PDF or Word file.

understand.title: Study sorts it out
understand.body: Topics, key terms and what you need to know, linked to your own text.

practice.title: Practice and review
practice.body: Flashcards, quiz questions and short study sessions that adjust to how you're doing.

return.title: Come back and improve
return.body: Study remembers what you find hard and has it ready next time.

product.title: What it looks like
product.lead: An example with a demo subject about inflation and purchasing power.
product.subject: Economics: Inflation & Purchasing Power
product.summaryBody1: Inflation means the general price level rises. With the same amount of money you can buy less, so your purchasing power falls.
product.summaryBody2: Whether you notice it depends on your income: if your wage rises as fast as prices, your real income stays the same.
product.quizQuestion: Your wage rises 2% and inflation is 5%. What happens to your real income?
product.quizFeedbackTitle: Almost. Let's look at it again.
product.quizFeedbackBody: Prices rise faster than your wage, so you can buy less. Your real income falls by about 3%.

grounded.title: Everything from your own material
grounded.body: Answers point to the passage where it says so. If it's not in there, Study tells you.

flashcards.title: Flashcards at the right moment
flashcards.body: Cards you find hard come back more often.

quizzes.title: Quizzes that explain
quizzes.body: Got it wrong? You see why, and where it says so in your material.

sessions.title: Study sessions that adapt
sessions.body: Doing well? It gets harder. Stuck? Study tries a different angle.

ask.title: Ask Study
ask.body: Ask questions about your material. Study only looks online when you say yes, and marks it clearly.

languages.title: Dutch and English
languages.body: Material in Dutch? You get explanations in English, with key terms as they appear in your text.

cta.title: Add your first chapter.

dashboard.title: Where do you want to start?

points.yours: Your material is yours. We don't sell it and we don't use it to train AI models.
